strata.name: m7e_final_stochastic
strata.inclusion_rule: all M7e final stochastic evaluation rows (3 seeds x 100)
strata.supports: per-seed break/miss frequencies of the final policies; the census for the M7e ceiling claims
strata.cannot_support: nothing about checkpoints other than final

strata.name: m7e_final_deterministic
strata.inclusion_rule: every unique M7e final deterministic sequence (one per seed, weight 100)
strata.supports: which targets the argmax policy of each seed takes

strata.name: m7e_checkpoint_curve
strata.inclusion_rule: all M7e initial and curve stochastic rows (100 + 9 x 60 per seed) and every unique initial/curve deterministic sequence
strata.supports: whether later checkpoints acquire targets earlier ones never break (checkpoint trajectory per seed)
strata.cannot_support: fine-grained per-checkpoint rates (60 episodes per point, SE ~ 0.06 on a rate)

strata.name: m7d_final
strata.inclusion_rule: all M7d final stochastic rows (6 runs x 100) and every unique M7d final deterministic sequence
strata.supports: M7d vs M7e and reward v1 vs v2 differences at the end of training, incl. seed 0 where v1 beat v2

strata.name: six_target_all
strata.inclusion_rule: every replayable six-target row anywhere (evaluation + preserved training)
strata.supports: which six-target subsets exist and which targets a six-target episode never contains
strata.cannot_support: how common each six-target subset is in training (37 of 47 training six-target rows have no actions)

strata.name: random_baseline
strata.inclusion_rule: the random-baseline rows that kept actions (3 per milestone, identical across milestones)
strata.supports: which targets random play reaches in the preserved episodes

strata.name: selection_bias_sample
strata.inclusion_rule: 200 unique replayable sequences not selected above, ordered by sha256('m7f-selection-bias-v1' + digest)
strata.supports: whether per-target frequencies in the targeted strata generalise to the rest of the replayable evidence
strata.cannot_support: the non-replayable rows (4,491 training rows, 97+97 random rows without actions)

m7e/initial/stochastic/pooled.note: the untrained policies (initial checkpoint, near-maximal entropy) of the three M7e seeds

m7e/curve/stochastic/pooled.note: all nine intermediate checkpoints of the three M7e seeds

training_replayable.note: preserved training artifacts only (a biased subset: new-best and periodic preservation)

six_target_all_rows.note: every replayable six-target row (evaluation + preserved training), weighted by rows

selection_bias_sample.note: rows of the deterministic hash sample of otherwise unselected replayable sequences

random_baseline_kept.note: the 3 kept random rows per milestone

tas_reference.note: Mario climbs to the wall's top ledge (y 3000 at tick 316), crosses over the wall top at y ~3400-3500 (ticks 340-358) and descends on the left side (min x -4071); several targets break while Mario is far from them (projectiles)
